prompt: Which finding best supports the man’s explanation rather than a general file-format problem?
promptZh: 哪個發現最能支持男方的解釋，而不是一般的檔案格式問題？

options.text: The older machine cannot open either file.
options.zh: 舊機器兩份檔案都打不開。
options.whyZh: 舊機器能開徽章檔，也能正常繡範例，並非兩份都打不開。

options.text: The plain-border file works on both machines, but the curved border changes on the older one.
options.zh: 簡單邊框的檔案在兩台都能正常刺繡，但曲線邊框在舊機器上變了樣。
options.whyZh: 普通邊框作為對照仍正常，只有舊機器處理曲線有異常，因此可以區分格式和特定設定。

options.text: Both borders change when stitched on the new machine.
options.zh: 兩種邊框用新機器刺繡時都變了樣。
options.whyZh: 新機器繡出的徽章正確，範例也正常，沒有兩種都變樣。

options.text: The two machines produce the same straight border from the badge file.
options.zh: 兩台機器用徽章檔案都繡出一樣的直線邊框。
options.whyZh: 同一徽章檔在新機器能繡對，只有舊機器繡成直線，成品不相同。

explanationZh: 普通邊框作為對照仍正常，只有舊機器處理曲線有異常，因此可以區分格式和特定設定。
evidence: The same file stitched the border correctly on the new machine. / And the sample file with a plain border ran fine on both. / The older machine can open these files. It just doesn’t understand the curved-border setting.

evidenceSpans.speaker: F
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The same file stitched the border correctly on the new machine.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: And the sample file with a plain border ran fine on both.

evidenceSpans.speaker: M
evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The older machine can open these files. It just doesn’t understand the curved-border setting.

vocabulary.note: 用於指定圖樣邊框為曲線的設定。
